messages:
emily-sre: :rotating_light: paging P1 — sudden spike in token verification errors across regions, 401s for console and APIs
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-0452 created: auth.verify.error_rate > 20% — auto-paged: ryan-oncall, jamie-platform
ryan-oncall: I'm taking this. Checking gateway logs and the JWK cache metrics. Please avoid config churn.
lisa-support: Multiple customer threads: console logins fail with "invalid_token" after SSO, mobile clients showing 401s.
jamie-platform: Tracing token introspect calls — seeing a wave of 502s from auth0 oauth/introspect in eu-west-1 and us-east-1. Sample trace ids attached.
emily-sre: Reproduced with curl from our edge:
```
curl -i -X POST https://auth0.com/oauth/introspect \
  -d 'token=eyJ...' -d 'client_id=redwood-svc' -H 'Authorization: Basic ***'
HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
```
ryan-oncall: Gateway treats 5xx from introspect as auth failure -> 401. That's killing sessions. What's our fallback behavior?
jamie-platform: Current config: verify_mode=online_introspect, fallback=none. We can flip to local_jwks_verify to validate signatures locally using cached JWKS. Tradeoff: tokens revoked upstream may be accepted until cache TTL expires.
emily-sre: Given impact to interactive sessions, temporary local verification acceptable. We'll accept small revocation window to restore logins.
ryan-oncall: Preparing a canary change to 10% of auth-proxy hosts. Don't alter routing yet.
jamie-platform: Applying canary:
```
redwoodctl config set auth-proxy.verify_mode local_jwks_verify --env prod --selector canary
redwoodctl rollout start auth-proxy --selector canary
```
ops-bot: Rollout started (canary): 2/20 hosts updated.
lisa-support: Can ops draft a short status page entry? Customers are asking.
emily-sre: Draft: "We're seeing authentication failures due to degraded introspection at an upstream provider. We've enabled a temporary local verification fallback to reduce login failures. Some users may need to re-login. We'll update shortly."
ryan-oncall: Canary results: error rate on canary hosts dropped from ~27% -> ~3%. Proceeding to 50%.
ops-bot: Rollout updated: 10/20 hosts patched.
jamie-platform: Pushing to 100%.
ops-bot: Rollout completed: 20/20 hosts patched.
incident-bot: Severity update: customer impact reduced to <5% sessions failing. Vendor notified with debug payloads.
emily-sre: Opened Auth0 support case 67891234 with request ids, timestamps, and response samples. Auth0 status: https://status.auth0.com/incident/abc123
auth0-status-bot: Auth0 acknowledges elevated errors on oauth/introspect and is investigating edge routing.
ryan-oncall: Security note — we must reconcile potential revoked tokens accepted during fallback. Create remediation ticket.
jamie-platform: Created RED-PRIV-145: postmortem & revocation reconciliation assigned to jamie-platform, emily-sre.
lisa-support: Tracking impacted tenants in CS tracker; flagged enterprise customers with console lockouts.
emily-sre: Metrics snapshot: peak ~12k introspects/min with ~2.4k failures/min; after fallback failures ~150/min. Suppressing related alert for 1h while degraded mode active.
ryan-oncall: Confirmed logs/observability ingest still healthy; problem isolated to upstream introspect returns.
jamie-platform: Recommend an automation play: auto-toggle to local_jwks_verify when vendor 5xx rate exceeds threshold. Filing RED-OPS-22.
emily-sre: Auth0 status update: "Edge cache misroute causing 502s; fix rolling out." ETA 30-60m.
auth0-status-bot: Update: partial mitigation deployed; errors trending down.
ryan-oncall: Running runbook step: annotate traces and search for 401 storms between 2630000000-2630003600.
jamie-platform: Keeping local_jwks_verify for brief stabilization window (15m) after vendor confirms recovery.
ops-bot: Temporary flags updated.
emily-sre: Customer impact assessment: approx 8% of interactive console sessions failed at peak; programmatic clients saw elevated 401s. No evidence of token compromise. Risk: moderate due to potential acceptance of revoked tokens for cache TTL.
lisa-support: Preparing customer communications; holding for final numbers and vendor confirmation.
ryan-oncall: Auth0 reports full recovery at 2630000520; our metrics normalized by 2630000600. Reverting to online introspect.
jamie-platform: Reverting config:
```
redwoodctl config set auth-proxy.verify_mode online_introspect --env prod
redwoodctl rollout start auth-proxy --all
```
ops-bot: Rollout completed across all hosts.
emily-sre: Post-change checks: introspect latency and 2xx rates normal; auth flows passing.
incident-bot: INC-2026-0452 mitigated — fallback enabled ~10m after onset; full recovery ~10-12m after vendor fix. Postmortem and timeline requested.
ryan-oncall: Handoff to evening oncall nina-oncall — see RED-PRIV-145 and Auth0 case 67891234. Follow-up: reconcile revocations and implement automation.
nina-oncall: Ack. I'll take next shift and monitor the ticket.
emily-sre: Leaving action items in RED-PRIV-145: (1) reconcile revocations vs JWKS cache TTL, (2) implement auto-fallback automation, (3) coordinate CS communications. Due 2026-03-16.
lisa-support: Sending interim status to impacted tenants with promise of postmortem later today :thumbsup:
ryan-oncall: Closing rotation. If Auth0 regresses, page ops channel. 
incident-bot: Pager duty rotation closed. Follow-ups tracked in RED-PRIV-145.
